entities.name: Emma Adbåge
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Emma Adbåge is a Swedish illustrator and children's writer. In addition to illustrating her own books, she contributes to works by other authors while also taking on commissions from educational publishers. In 2013, she was awarded the Elsa Beskow Plaque for her illustrated Lenis Olle and other works for children.
